description: Find parameter codes supported by a community and temporalResolution. Every whitespace-separated filter token must match code, name or definition, ignoring case. Filtering covers the complete dictionary before sorted pagination. Codes NASA lists but does not serve at that resolution are left out, and a notice names any the filter matched. Blank filter browses all codes; pass returned codes to a producing tool.

limit.description: Positive maximum entry count; values above 100 use an effective cap of 100

offset.description: Zero-based offset within all filtered matches

name: nasa_power_search_parameters

calculated.description: Whether NASA reports this parameter as calculated

inputs.description: Original calculation inputs, including explicit null

source.description: Reported source dataset or calculation provider

units.description: Exact parameter units for the selected pair

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_rate_limited`: NASA rate limits dictionary retrieval. `request_queue_full`: Source scheduling capacity is exhausted. `dataset_limit`: Dictionary response exceeds the bounded source body limit. `upstream_rejected`: NASA rejects dictionary retrieval. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limit.description: Effective maximum entry count, capped at 100

notice.description: Effective output cap, matched codes left out because NASA does not serve them at this resolution, or guidance when the complete filter has no matches

total.description: Total matches across the complete dictionary, excluding codes NASA does not serve

truncated.description: Whether matching entries remain after this page

title: Search NASA POWER parameters
